arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'CA'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose merchant location is in California (state code 'CA').
assumptions: All transactions are counted, labelled or not, across the full data range 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, including those with negative amounts or errors.
